newsitem.title: USA: 3DX sees strong fundamentals amid Q2 loss.
newsitem.headline: 3DX sees strong fundamentals amid Q2 loss.

text.p: 3DX Technologies Inc said Wednesday the fundamentals for its business remain strong, despite reporting a loss in the second quarter.
The oil and gas exploration company posted a net loss of $461,000, or $0.06 a share, for the quarter ended June 30, compared with a $1.4 milion loss, or $0.49 a share, the year before.

3DX had $923,000 in revenues in the quarter, compared with $249,000 last year. Its oil and gas production averaged the equivalent of 3.5 million cubic-feet a day in the second quarter, up 30 percent over the first quarter.
"The fundamentals of the business remain strong for 3DX," a company statement said.
3DX said it added 15 new projects in the first half (eight during in the second quarter) and increased its average working interest in the projects to 20 percent, from less than 10 percent in 1996.
